chart_metadata.name: shoutrrr

runAsContext.description: Shoutrrr runs as root and drops privileges to www-data

capabilities.name: NET_BIND_SERVICE

capabilities.name: SETFCAP
capabilities.description: Shoutrrr is able to set file capabilities.

capabilities.name: KILL
capabilities.description: Shoutrrr is able to send process signals.

capabilities.name: SYS_PTRACE
capabilities.description: Shoutrrr is able to trace processes for Octane/FrankenPHP.
